HediffDef.label: Hoffan feeding resistance
HediffDef.description: A persistent protein-based treatment interferes with the biochemical preparation a Wraith normally releases into prey before draining Life Force. Wraith feeding is blocked, but the prototype treatment also weakens ordinary immune response.

HediffDef.label: Hoffan serum systemic failure
HediffDef.description: The prototype Hoffan serum is triggering the catastrophic reaction that killed roughly half of its original recipients. Multiple physiological systems are failing despite the treatment's successful anti-Wraith effect.

HediffDef.label: Hoffan serum poisoning
HediffDef.description: Hoffan serum transferred back through a feeding attempt has reacted with Wraith feeding chemistry and is causing rapidly progressive systemic organ failure.
